//: V17.5 PRIORITY 3 — resume point: a deterministic VIEW over committed records (no new registry). Read trackedItems[].next and nextGoAction first; every value cites its source. Recompute: npx tsx runtime/bin/odg-resume-point.ts [--prs <file>] ; verify: --check.

rules.RSP-1: tracked items = every WORK_ITEM_CONTRACT item that has an owner authorization block, OR is the register decision's selected/proposed item, OR is named by a committed GO trace (DISPATCHED mission, CYCLE_END selection.workingOn / selection.strategic); every other register item is summarised by status count only (its record stays in the register)
rules.RSP-2: step state = odg-authorization-scope.deriveAuthorizationScope(contract, records, local-git R7 probes) where, per record kind, the record is (a) the register loader's V<n>_<scenario>_<KIND>.json (register.sourcesUsed.authorizationEvidence), else (b) the contract-declared path (authorization.inspectionRecord; authorization.dispatchTargets.RUN_CONTROLLED_EXPERIMENTS.writeSet[0] for the experiment), else (c) V<n>_<short>_<KIND>.json with short = scenario minus a leading 'V<n>-'; when this differs from the register's CLOSE-1 view (closure.currentStep / closed) the divergence is REPORTED (never resolved here)
rules.RSP-3: last GO run of an item = the committed GO trace cycle with the latest CYCLE_END.endedAt whose dispatchedMissions or selection.workingOn names the item
rules.RSP-4: next action by current step: CLOSED_* ⇒ none (new mission only); INSPECT_REVISED_CONTRACT ⇒ INDEPENDENT_INSPECTOR commits an inspection record; RUN_CONTROLLED_EXPERIMENTS authorized and never dispatched ⇒ GO --execute dispatches the declared target; RUN_CONTROLLED_EXPERIMENTS already dispatched by GO with no committed experiment record ⇒ PROVIDER collects the runner's record (never re-run: one-shot claim); VALIDATE_CRITERIA ⇒ PROVIDER commits the criteria-validation record (R5b) + INDEPENDENT_INSPECTOR inspects it; no authorized step and contract not AUTHORIZED ⇒ OWNER (PROPOSED → AUTHORIZED); ODG never self-authorizes
rules.RSP-5: next GO action = the register decision record (strategic choice) + the tracked items whose authorized current step is an EXECUTION step not yet dispatched (what a GO --execute run could dispatch); when there is none, GO has nothing to dispatch and the pending steps are provider / inspector / owner steps (listed)
